propositions: Test test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails on dev hosts with ambient command-scope git-config injection but passes in CI due to unfiltered os.environ inheritance in git() and bare_git() harness helpers.

The git() and bare_git() subprocess calls inherit GIT_CONFIG_* environment variables from the host agent harness, causing bare repository operations to fail with 'safe.bareRepository is explicit' fatal error.

The matrix test and sibling heldout tests (21 total failures) pass after scrubbing GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*, and GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS from harness subprocess environment and pinning GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1.
Monkeypatching the hostile GIT_CONFIG_* injection unconditionally into the matrix test ensures deterministic regression coverage in CI while preserving the gh-independence held-out contract.
